name: What should I ask a contractor before starting a bathroom expansion?

mainEntity.name: What are the key questions to ask before hiring someone for a bathroom expansion project?
mainEntity.text: What are the key questions to ask before hiring someone for a bathroom expansion project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting a bathroom expansion, homeowners should ask clear questions about scope, experience, and project management. The most important topics are permits, structural changes, plumbing relocation, material lead times, and how hidden damage is handled if it appears behind the walls. It is also smart to ask whether the contractor has completed similar bathroom expansions in homes with older framing or tight footprints. Ask who will be on site, who handles inspections, how changes are approved, and what happens if the design needs to shift after demolition. A good contractor should be able to explain the sequence of work from demolition through finish installation and give a realistic timeline. Homeowners should also request examples of finished bathrooms with a similar budget or style so expectations match the project. The best conversations happen before work begins, not after a surprise appears in the wall. A strong contractor will make the process understandable and help the homeowner avoid scope creep, schedule delays, and budget shocks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask how they handle permits, structural changes, plumbing relocation, hidden damage, timelines, material allowances, and change orders. You should also ask to see similar bathroom expansion projects and confirm who manages inspections and day-to-day communication.
